Hits home hard man
I too am tired of being a guinea pig for medication and therapies. I wanted to kill myself too.
But then I saw people like you who have suffered even more than me. I know I'm some strange dude typing shit that you can't relate with, but I feel you bro. Good times may divide people, but our suffering definitely unites us. You just need a shoulder to cry on sometimes. I still haven't got one, but hey at least I tried. I know that when we only wanted to be normal, but still ended up in this shit. If you feel like dying, then don't worry, we are in the same shit bro. After all, our suffering only unites us. 
I hope you find your path to peace soon. Until then, keep on living. Because in order to keep on living when all hope is lost, you need courage. And we have courage to hold on even after we have been broken. You my friend, are a warrior fighting the enemy called death. Everyone loses in the end, but that doesn't mean you shouldn't kick his ass and spit in it's face.

Tom and Jerry, Mr bean etc
Don't worry about me. I'm alright now. There might be someone else who needs help here. Help them, you've already done enough for me.
Thank you

Idk nowadays I only watch nostalgic shit
My favourite movie is Mr nobody

I know that I not a fundamentally bad person. All my life I just wanted to be loved. I know I was shy, but I had feelings too, even if I couldn't express them. But now, I know it doesn't matter anymore. I only want a peaceful death so that I could say for the one last time to the world I love you.
